statement: Pinned Linux hid-wiimote-modules.c decodes acceleration bits from incoming Wii reports and forwards the resulting counts through three EV_ABS axes, without consulting EEPROM accelerometer calibration in that input-report code path. The driver code path is consumer-side presentation, not evidence of factory calibration or a universally uncalibrated client.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: hid-wiimote-modules.c 419-506; axes transmitted as raw-ish report counts in this handler, no physical calibration analysis.
